landing.title: The bridge between suppliers, sellers and customers
landing.subtitle: TradeBridge connects Tunisian suppliers, independent sellers and delivery agencies on one trusted platform — with cash on delivery, moderated communication, and full logistics tracking.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for how Tunisian commerce actually works
landing.feature1Body: Browse supplier catalogs, sell on Facebook/Instagram/TikTok, and create the order only when a real customer buys.
landing.feature2Body: List your products once — sellers across the country discover and sell them for you.
landing.feature3Title: Full logistics, tracked end to end
landing.feature3Body: Every product is scanned in, boxed, and handed to a courier — with a complete audit trail.
